name: Review archive policy and defaults
title: Review archive policy and defaults
description:
Set archive defaults before ingest: retention period and state policy, checksum requirement, whether external storage references are allowed, integrity-check schedule, and nearby-camera alert radius/roles. Confirm the storage backend choice and ownership responsibilities with your records/privacy lead.

A retention default is not a substitute for an approved retention schedule, legal hold, or deletion procedure. Enable external references only if the corresponding storage scope and access controls are documented. Do not put secrets in free-text notes.
